info.title: Motus CLI
info.description: Command-line interface for Motus browser automation. Provides test execution, recording, browser installation, and utility commands.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: run
commands.description: Discover and execute tests from assemblies

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter tests by name substring

options.name: --reporter
options.description: Reporter format: console | junit:<path> | html:<path> | trx:<path>. Repeat the flag for multiple reporters (e.g. --reporter console --reporter junit:r.xml).

options.name: --workers
options.description: Number of parallel workers (or 'auto')

options.name: --visual
options.description: Launch visual test runner

options.name: --a11y
options.description: Enable accessibility audits (warn or enforce)

options.name: --perf-budget
options.description: Enable performance budget enforcement from config

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Enable coverage reporting: console | html:<dir> | cobertura:<path>. Repeat the flag for multiple formats (e.g. --coverage console --coverage html:./out).

options.name: --retries
options.description: Re-run a failing test up to N additional times. Which failures are retried depends on --retry-policy. Default: 0 (no retries).

options.name: --retry-policy
options.description: Which failures --retries re-runs: 'transient' (only CDP disconnects, the default) or 'flake' (any failure; a test that then passes is reported as flaky). Flake detection needs --retries >= 1.

options.name: --fail-on-flaky
options.description: Make the run exit non-zero when any test is flaky. By default flaky tests pass the run with a warning.

options.name: --quarantine
options.description: Path to a quarantine list file (one fully qualified test name per line; '#' comments allowed). Listed tests run but their failures do not gate the run.

options.name: --flaky-history
options.description: Path to a JSON file that accumulates per-test run/failure/flaky-pass counts across runs.

options.name: --shard
options.description: Run only one shard of the suite: <index>/<total>, 1-based (e.g. --shard 1/4). Discovered tests are partitioned deterministically across shards so independent runs (one per CI agent) cover disjoint subsets. Write each shard to its own result file (e.g. results.shard-1.xml) and combine them with 'motus shard merge'.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge per-shard result files into one aggregate report

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the merged report: junit:<path> | trx:<path>. Repeat the flag for multiple formats. Omit to print only the console summary.

options.name: --expect
options.description: Assert exactly N shards are present, read from the coordinates each shard stamped into its file. Fails the merge if a shard is missing or duplicated.

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: Per-shard result files to merge (JUnit or TRX). A glob like results.shard-*.xml is accepted if the shell did not expand it.

commands.name: check-selectors
commands.description: Validate recorded selectors against live pages

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Path to a *.selectors.json manifest. When provided, selectors are checked against their recorded PageUrl.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Base URL to check every selector against. Required when --manifest is not provided.

options.name: --ci
options.description: Exit with a non-zero status code if any selector is broken.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the full check results as JSON to the given path.

options.name: --fix
options.description: Apply High-confidence repair suggestions to source files.

options.name: --no-backup
options.description: Do not write .bak files when applying fixes.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Open the visual runner to review and apply repairs one selector at a time.

arguments.name: GLOB
arguments.description: Glob pattern for C# source files to scan (e.g. "./Tests/**/*.cs")

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run the Motus MCP server for agent clients (stdio by default, or --http)

options.name: --headless
options.description: Run the browser without a visible window

options.name: --channel
options.description: Browser channel to drive (chromium, chrome, edge, firefox)

options.name: --connect
options.description: Drive a browser that is already running instead of starting one. Takes the debugging endpoint it was started with (http://127.0.0.1:9222) or its CDP WebSocket URL. The browser is never closed by the server

options.name: --http
options.description: Serve over Streamable HTTP for concurrent remote clients instead of stdio

options.name: --host
options.description: Host/interface to bind when --http is set

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port to listen on when --http is set

options.name: --token
options.description: Bearer token required on every HTTP request (or set MOTUS_MCP_TOKEN). Required when binding a non-loopback host.

options.name: --viewport
options.description: Viewport size for every page as WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1920x1080 (default 1280x800)

options.name: --record-video
options.description: Record a video of every page into this directory (MJPEG AVI, one file per page)

options.name: --show-cursor
options.description: Draw an on-screen pseudo-cursor in screenshots and recordings (follows the element cursor style and shows a click effect); enables natural mouse motion unless --natural-mouse is set explicitly

options.name: --natural-mouse
options.description: Humanize mouse movement with curved, eased paths. Defaults to the value of --show-cursor; pass --natural-mouse false to keep the cursor without it
